title: San Francisco used a proposed overhead rate after a lower energy-grant rate was approved

beats.text: Two federal energy grant entries appeared in San Francisco’s 2012 filing.

visual.sub: The federal filing separates direct and pass-through energy funds

beats.text: One was direct. The other passed through an intermediary.

visual.kicker: The federal filing separates direct and pass-through energy funds

beats.text: The finding applied to the row reporting $257,842 in spending.
The Environment department built its budget using a proposed overhead rate.

visual.kicker: The proposed overhead rate exceeded the approved rate

beats.text: That rate determined the administrative costs it charged to the grant.

visual.kicker: The proposed overhead rate exceeded the approved rate

beats.text: Its approved rate was lower. Its reimbursement claims used the higher proposal.

visual.kicker: The proposed overhead rate exceeded the approved rate

beats.text: Auditors questioned costs without publishing the amount in their testimony.

visual.kicker: The proposed overhead rate exceeded the approved rate

beats.text: The department told supervisors it had corrected the rate with its funder.

visual.kicker: The next audit independently confirmed the change

beats.text: The independent auditor returned at the next annual hearing.

visual.kicker: The next audit independently confirmed the change

beats.text: It confirmed through additional testing that the department corrected the finding.

visual.kicker: The next audit independently confirmed the change

beats.text: The hearings give no amount for a refund or an offset.
